x-k-k7-05.title: 3:00 ma waa wakhtiga kama dambeysta ama bilowga?
x-k-k7-05.goal: Dib u eeg xukunka waxa fariin la gudbiyay ay macneyso marka caddayn cusub timaado, oo dib u qor fariinta si ay u hayso faahfaahintii lumay.
x-k-k7-05.material: 두리 berri ayaa aadaya fasal gaar ah. Macluumaadku wuxuu gaaraa 두리 qaybo. Mar kasta go'aami waxa aad rumaysan tahay, ka dibna akhri waxa xiga.
x-k-k7-05.thinking.1: Dib u eegista marka caddayn cusub timaado
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Raac fariimaha oo mar kasta go'aami goorta 두리 ay tahay in la yimaado.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Marxalad kasta, qor jawaabtaada ka hor intaadan akhrin doorashooyinka.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii fariin cusub ay waafaqsan tahay tii hore, weydii haddii ay ku darto faahfaahin.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.info: 하나 ayaa u sheegay 두리 jaranjarada: '선생님이 내일 3시까지 오래.'
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Goorma ayaa 두리 u baahan yahay in halkaas laga joogo?
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.after: 까지 wuxuu dejiyaa wakhtiga ugu dambeeya: halkaas ahow ilaa 3:00.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Saacadda 3:00 saxda ah, ma goor hore.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 까지 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa xad, ma aha wakhti sax ah.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 까지 wuxuu dejiyaa wakhtiga ugu dambeeya, sidaas darteed imaanshaha ka dib 3:00 horeba wuu dambeeyay.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.info: 반장 ayaa u qoray 소희 sheeko fasalka: '수업은 3시에 시작한대.'
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Labada fariinba waa run noqon karaan, wada jir ahaan waxay daayaan furan sida goor hore 두리 loo imaan karo. Aqbalaadda labadaba waa fiican tahay, laakiin gudbin soo gaabiyay ayaa laga yaabaa inay faahfaahin tuurtay, sidaas darteed tallaabada xigta ee ugu fiican waa in la ogaado erayada saxda ah ee macallinka.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Labada fariinba way is diidaan; iska dhaaf tii ugu horreysay.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Fariimaha ma is diidaan: imaanshaha ka hor wakhtiga bilowga waa suurtagal.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Labada fariinba way isku waafaqsan yihiin; waxba maqan ma muuqdaan.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Suurtagal, laakiin gudbin soo gaabiyay ayaa tuuri karta faahfaahin. Fasalku wuxuu bilaabmaa 3:00, sidaas darteed weydii waxa macallinku runtii ka yidhi sida goor hore loo imaan lahaa.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Fasalku wuxuu bilaabmaa 3:00; 'by 3:00' laga yaabo inay lumisay faahfaahin.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad ogaatay in fariin gaaban oo la gudbiyay ay laga yaabo inayan ahayn fariinta oo dhan.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.2.info: 하나 ayaa xusuusta erayada saxda ah ee macallinka: '수업은 3시에 시작하니까 10분 전까지 오세요.'
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Gudbinta 3시까지 waxay lumisay '10분 전'. Asalku wuxuu bixiyaa sabab (fasalku wuxuu bilaabmaa 3) iyo wakhti (10 daqiiqo ka hor).
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad isticmaashay erayada asalka ah ee macallinka, ma aha gudbinta soo gaabiyay.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Taasi waxay ahayd gudbinta soo gaabiyay; asalku wuxuu dejiyaa wakhti hore.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Taasi waxay u akhrisaa 10분 sida wakhti dambe; 전 macnaheedu waa ka hor.
x-k-k7-05.s.s1.reflect: Gudbinno gaaban waxay tuuri karaan tirooyin ama sababo. Marka laba fariin ay u muuqdaan inay ku habboon yihiin, weydii haddii tii ugu horreysay ay tahay sheekada oo dhan.
x-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor fariinta saxda ah hooyada 두리 (qaab edeb leh): waxa 두리 la sameeyo, oo ku jira faahfaahintii lumay.
x-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ku dar wakhtiga bilowga fasalka iyo wakhtiga imaanshaha hore labadaba.
x-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dheh sida wax 두리 u baahan yahay in la sameeyo, tusaale dhammaad soo sheegis sida -래요 ama 와야 해요.
x-k-k7-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hooyada 두리 ma garan lahayd inay timaado ka hor bilowga fasalka?
x-k-k7-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma soo sheegay tilmaan, ma aha xaqiiqo?

x-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Su'aalaha kuwee ayuu 지우 weydiin doonaa 하나 si 엄마 u diyaariso waxa saxda ah? Dooro dhammaan kuwa loo baahan yahay.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qiyaas 엄마 caawa iibsi: maxay weli ogaan lahayn?
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tuur su'aalaha jawaabtoodu aysan beddeli doonin waxa 엄마 sameyso.

x-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Halka 하나 ka maqashay ma beddesho waxa 엄마 u baahan tahay inay sameyso.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in '준비물' keligiis aanu sheegin shayga.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.c: 선생님이 웃으면서 말했어요? (Macallinku ma dhoola cadeeyay?)
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Dareenka macallinku ma beddelo waxa la diyaarinayo.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ogaatay in wakhti kama dambeys ah uu qayb ka yahay hawsha.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.e: Waxaad aragtay in tirada sidoo kale go'aamiso waxa 엄마 iibsato.
x-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: 엄마 waxay u baahan tahay inay ogaato maxay, goorma ilaa iyo imisa. Halka 하나 ka maqashay ama in macallinku dhoola cadeeyay ma beddesho waxa la diyaarinayo.
x-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: 하나 ayaa ka jawaabay: '색연필이야. 금요일까지. 12색으로 한 통.' Hadda u sheeg 엄마 Kuuriyaan waxa 선생님 yidhi (qaab edeb leh).
x-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal 선생님이 ... iyo dhammaad soo sheegis tilmaan ah.
x-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dhig shayga, wakhtiga kama dambeysta iyo tirada hal ama laba weedhood.
x-k-k7-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Fariintaydu ma u oggolaanaysaa 엄마 inay diyaarisato iyadoon wax kale weydiin?
x-k-k7-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma soo sheegay tilmaan (keen), ma aha xaqiiqo?

x-k-k7-03.title: Casho qoys ah oo laga dhisay afar fariin
x-k-k7-03.goal: Akhri fariimo qof ilaa qof loo gudbiyay, u beddel xadaynno sax ah, oo hel dhowr qorshe oo ilaaliya dhammaantood.
x-k-k7-03.material:
Qoyskaaga ayaa qorsheynaya casho dhalashada 할머니. Wakhtiyada oo dhan waa fiidnimo (오후). Afar qof ayaa gudbiyay fariimo:

엄마: '아빠가 7시 전에는 못 온대. 아빠가 와야 먹을 수 있어.'
이모: '동생이 9시 전에는 먹기 시작해야 한대. 9시부터 학원에 가거든.'
삼촌: '할머니께서 10시에는 주무신대. 그때까지 식사가 끝나야 해.'
고모: '의사 선생님이 할머니는 천천히 한 시간 이상 드시래. 그렇지만 두 시간 넘게는 앉아 계시지 말래.'
x-k-k7-03.thinking.0: U beddelidda hadalka la gudbiyay xadaynno (ka hor, ilaa, ugu badnaan)
x-k-k7-03.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa wakhtiyo sida 7시 iyo 9시
x-k-k7-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu arkay weedho 'qof ayaa ii sheegay ...' fasalka; 전에, 까지 iyo 넘게 waxaa lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
x-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Maxay 고모 gudbisaa adigoo isticmaalaya '두 시간 넘게는 앉아 계시지 말래'?
x-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore u tarjun 두 시간 넘게, ka dibna dhammaadka 말래.

x-k-k7-03.s.s1.r.b: Weedhdu waxay dejisaa xad, ma weydiisato hal dherer oo sax ah.
x-k-k7-03.s.s1.o.c: Cuntadu waxay socon kartaa ugu badnaan 2 saacadood.
x-k-k7-03.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad si sax ah isugu dartay 넘게 (ka dhaaf) iyo 말래 (ha samayn).

x-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Hel 3 qorshe casho oo kala duwan oo raaca afarta fariin. s = saacadda casho ka bilaabmo, e = saacadda casho ku dhammaato (saacado dhan, fiidnimo).

x-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore dooro bilowga (saacadaha kuwee ayaa harsan?), ka dibna dhammaadka.

x-k-k7-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Cuntadu waa inay noqotaa ugu yaraan hal saac (fariinta 고모).
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Cuntadu ma noqon karto ka dheer laba saacadood (fariinta 고모).
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.explain: Qorshayaasha suurtagalka ah waa 7-8, 7-9, 8-9 iyo 8-10. Tusaale 7 ilaa 9 wuxuu bilaabmaa ka dib marka 아빠 yimaado, wuxuu bilaabmaa ka hor 9, wuxuu dhammaadaa ka hor 10 wuxuuna socdaa 2 saacadood.
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.because.prompt: U sheeg 아빠 (qaab edeb leh) qorshahaaga: goorta casho ay bilaabmaan iyo ku dhammaadaan, iyo hal sabab oo ka timid fariin aad gudbinayso.
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dooro hal ka mid ah qorshayaashaada, ka dibna hal ka mid ah afarta fariin ee xadaysa.
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isticmaal dhammaad soo sheegis (-대요, -래요, -다고 했어요) sababta.
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakhtiyada qoraalkayga ma waafaqsan yihiin mid ka mid ah qorshayaashayda?
x-k-k7-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Sababtu runtii ma ku jirtaa mid ka mid ah afarta fariin?

x-k-k7-01.title: Yaa runtii iibsaday keegga?
x-k-k7-01.goal: Miisaami dhowr bayaan oo la gudbiyay, ogow yaa warbixin kasta tilmaamaysa, oo go'aami sheegashada caddayntu ugu wanaagsan taageerto.
x-k-k7-01.material:
Fasalkaagu wuxuu iibsaday keeg dhalasho macallinka, 은서 na wuxuu weydiiyay saddex fasal-wadaag yaa bixiyay. Kuwaasi waa qoraalada 은서 ee erayadeeda u gaar ah:

1) 민호는 자기가 케이크를 샀대요.
2) 수빈이는 민호가 케이크를 샀다고 했어요.
3) 지후는 수빈이가 케이크를 샀대요.

Fiiro gaar ah: 자기 halkan wuxuu dib ugu tilmaamayaa qofka ah mawduuca weedhda.
x-k-k7-01.thinking.0: Ka gaarista erayada asalka ah warbixin
x-k-k7-01.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa weedho Kuuriyaan gaaban oo leh dhammaadyo edeb leh
x-k-k7-01.prereq.1: Wuu arkay weedho nooca 'qof ayaa yiri ...' fasalka
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Qoraalka 1, maxay 민호 u badan tahay inuu 은서 isagu u sheegay?
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: Weydii naftaada yaa mawduuca qoraalka 1, oo yaa 자기 tilmaamaysaa.
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qiyaas inaad tahay 민호 oo si toos ah u hadlaysa: eraygee ayaad naftaada u isticmaali lahayd?
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.a: Hadluhu naadir ayuu naftiisa ku magacaabaa qofka saddexaad; 자기 qoraalka ku jira wuxuu dib ugu tilmaamayaa hadlaha.
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad akhrisay 자기 sida tilmaan dib u tilmaamaya hadlaha, sidaa darteed wuxuu ka hadlay naftiisa.
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.c: Taasi waxay magacaabaysaa qof kale; hubi yaa 자기 tilmaamaysaa qoraalka.
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: Weedh taban waxaa lagu warbixin lahaa 안 샀대요; qoraalku ma laha diidmo.
x-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 자기 wuxuu dib ugu tilmaamayaa 민호, mawduuca. Marka uu ka hadlayo naftiisa wuxuu odhan lahaa 제가/내가 (aniga), warbixintuna waxay u beddeshaa 자기.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya saddexda qoraal oo dhan, yaa inta badan iibsaday keegga?
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tiri intee qoraal ayaa qof kasta tilmaamaya.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ma jiraa qoraal si toos ah uga yimid qofka uu magacaabayo?
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.r.a: Tani waxay ku salaysan tahay hal warbixin (qoraalka 3) oo labada qoraal ee kale aanay taageerin.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.r.b: 지후 wuxuu ka muuqdaa kaliya sida wariye; qoraal midna ma leh wuu iibsaday.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad raadisay jawaabta ay taageeraan qoraalada ugu badan, oo ay ku jirto bayaanka qofka laftiisa.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.o.d: Ma jiro qof waxba sheegi kara
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.r.d: Jawaabo qaar ayaa ka wanaagsan taageero xitaa marka aadan 100% hubin.
x-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Qoraalka 1 waa sheegashada 민호 laftiisa oo qoraalka 2 ayaa ku celiyaa. Kaliya qoraalka 3 ayaa magacaabaya 수빈. Jawaabta ugu wanaagsan ee la taageeray waa 민호, in kasta oo macluumaad dheeraad ahi weli beddeli karo.
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan, sharax doorashadaada 2-3 weedhood. Caddayntee ayaad isticmaashay, oo maxay ku dhimi lahayd hubintaada?
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sheeg qoraalada isku raacsan iyo kan aan raacsanayn.
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sheeg erayada yaa ay yihiin kuwa uu qofka laftiisa (gacan koowaad) aad haysato iyo kuwa aad kaliya gacan labaad ka haysato.
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaalay bayaanka qofka laftiisa sida caddayn?
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay intee qoraal ayaa taageeraya jawaabtayda?
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma magacaabay wax fikradayda beddeli kara?
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.0: Waxaa laga yaabaa 민호. Wuxuu leeyahay isagu ayaa sameeyay (자기), 수빈 na isla wax ayuu yidhi, sidaa darteed laba warbixin ayaa is raacsan. Kaliya 지후 ayaa magacaabaya 수빈, sidaa darteed kaasi wuu is khilaafsan yahay. Waxaan ka yaraan lahaa hubinta haddii 수빈 ay kaliya ka maqashay 민호, sababtoo ah markaas ma aha il gooni ah.
x-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.1: 민호예요. 민호 자기가 샀다고 했고 수빈이도 같은 말을 했어요. 지후만 달라요. Waxaan weydiin lahaa 지후 sida uu u ogyahay.

x-k-k7-02.goal: Ka hel warbixinta qofka khaldan tilmaamaysa, hagaaji, oo sheeg fikradda guud ee hagaajinta ka dambeysa.
x-k-k7-02.material:
오빠 wuxuu u reebay walaashiis yar 지아 fariin cod ah:

'지아야, 엄마한테 전해 줘. 오늘 나 늦게 가. 저녁은 먼저 드시라고 해. 그리고 나한테는 전화하지 말라고 해. 내일은 일찍 나가.'
